<function=python>

# Explore player movement - try multiple RIGHTs to find vertical passages

print(f"Player start: cols {min(p[1] for p in player['boundary'])}-{max(p[1] for p in player['boundary'])}")

# Try RIGHT multiple times to explore
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])

    player2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    pcols = [p[1] for p in player2['boundary']]
    prows = [p[0] for p in player2['boundary']]
    print(f"RIGHT #{i+1}: cols {min(pcols)}-{max(pcols)}, rows {min(prows)}-{max(prows)}, level={result.get('level_completed')}")
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        break
